orders.instruction: Preserve the credited three-level policy. On the first unsolved level, learn which actions change the board; suppress repeated no-op state/action pairs, add visited-state avoidance, and re-detect objects and goals after each level transition.

Preserve the credited first level. Probe the next level's keyboard and click effects separately; 22 distinct states suggests limited exploration. Track visited state/action pairs, try untested actions when revisiting a state, and rebuild the object map after transitions.

Adapt lp85's credited click policy. Learn tn36's component boundaries and click effects online instead of copying coordinates. Probe each component, compare before/after observations, and use productive changes to infer the objective; avoid repeated state/click pairs.

summary: Use all three slots: extend two credited policies and transfer the fully credited click donor to a game with four zero-level attempts. No crossover is eligible. Stop further scheduling at 85% budget use.
